rupture_points.title: OrderStatusChanged dispatch outside transaction
rupture_points.evidence: Admin changeStatus fires OrderStatusChanged AFTER db:transaction closes (line 2231). transactionLevel()=0 so immediate dispatch. If controller crashes post-commit, event is lost.
rupture_points.live_test: Seal order, transition DELIVERED. Verify dispatch outside tx and no outbox row.

rupture_points.title: OrderStatusChanged payload lacks fiscal metadata

rupture_points.title: Dual OrderCreated fire with idempotency mitigation gap
rupture_points.evidence: Cash orders fire OrderCreated at line 607 and finalizePaidKioskOrder at line 1314. Idempotency absorbs via firstOrCreate, but wasRecentlyCreated=false on second listener prevents afterCommit broadcast.
rupture_points.live_test: Create kiosk CASH. Verify ONE OrderCreated row. If finalizePaidKioskOrder executes, listener returns at line 59.

rupture_points.title: Race: fiscal alloc failure vs OrderCreated dispatch
rupture_points.evidence: OrderCreated::dispatch registered before fiscal alloc attempts. If alloc throws (line 1208), tx rolls back but afterCommit callback already queued.
rupture_points.live_test: Mock FiscalSequenceService::next() to throw after lockForUpdate. Verify OrderCreated dispatch still queued and fires post-rollback.

rupture_points.title: Nullable payment_method in event payload
rupture_points.evidence: payment_method can be null (line 141-147 resolvePaymentMethod). JSON encode/decode may cause JS type coercion issues if not handled.
rupture_points.live_test: Create order with null payment_method. Verify KDS deserialization handles null gracefully.

result.verifier_summary: Re-verification confirms: P0-001 and P0-002 TRUE. Added NEW P1-001 (OrderStatusChanged dispatch outside tx, no outbox). P1-002 (OrderStatusChanged payload lacks fiscal). rupture_points.title: Deleted row returns event_type=null [EXPECTED BY DESIGN]

rupture_points.title: Concurrent listeners dispatch twice [UNIQUE INDEX PREVENTS]

result.verifier_summary: W2 adversarial re-verify: 4 false claims (R1/R2/R6 hallucinations, R3 misdescription). Mechanism verified sound: idempotency (UNIQUE), atomic claims (lock), retry lanes (rescue/retry-failed), escalation (wired). Actual risk substantially lower. No critical defects found.

rupture_points.title: Recalled order may vanish if pushed past 50-item limit

rupture_points.title: PREPARING→PREPARED loses broadcast on idempotent retry
rupture_points.evidence: Idempotency key on (event_type, order_id, old_status, new_status, correlation_id); retry same key returns existing row, wasRecentlyCreated=false, skips dispatch.
rupture_points.live_test: Kill WS; chef POSTs status change (202, no broadcast); manual retry of same POST; verify no new outbox entry; other station never sees transition unless polling.

rupture_points.title: Guest role check in channel auth may fail if role table broken
rupture_points.evidence: Guest (branch_id=0) role check requires hasRole(Admin); latent: hasRole() may fail/cache, guest sees all branches.
rupture_points.live_test: Create guest; add Admin role manually; attempt Echo.private('branch.1') sub; verify it succeeds (should fail); check WS frames for private-branch.1.

rupture_points.title: Status change without updated_at bump silently gated by poll
rupture_points.evidence: computeOrderVersion() uses updated_at unix seconds; status-only change without touch() is gated; TODO: awaiting status_changed_at column.
rupture_points.live_test: Direct SQL: UPDATE orders SET status=8 WHERE id=123 (no updated_at); call sync; verify order gated. Then touch updated_at; verify order returns.

result.verifier_summary: All 7 original rupture points verified as code-accurate. W3-R5 (idempotency + broadcast loss on retry) is confirmed P1 at PersistOrderStatusChangedToOutbox.php:27-33 + 65-66. W3-R6 confirmed at channels.php:41-62 (latent role-corruption). No false positives; all claims grounded in source verification.

rupture_points.title: Queue worker death: unbroadcast domain_events never recovered
rupture_points.evidence: Polling reads only orders table (line 96-117), NOT domain_events. Worker death leaves events with dispatched_at=null. Kitchen blind until worker restarts.
rupture_points.live_test: Kill queue:work, submit order. Polling returns it (DB-backed). Verify domain_events unbroadcast. Restart worker—broadcasts resume.

rupture_points.title: WS auth error <3x: silent degradation to polling, no operator alert
rupture_points.evidence: On subscription_error, counter increments (line 176). Before 3-fail threshold, no visible toast/banner. Polling fallback (line 236-246) engages silently.
rupture_points.live_test: Emit pusher:subscription_error once. Verify: (1) no toast, (2) wsService.state=CONNECTED, (3) polling active. Repeat 3x—then SESSION_INVALID fires.

rupture_points.title: Double-tap: idempotency prevents duplicate orders
rupture_points.evidence: UUID v4 key stored per session (line 708). Double POST both send same X-Idempotency-Key. acquire() atomic (line 99-124). Result: 1 order.
rupture_points.live_test: Load kiosk, double-tap Payer within 100ms. Verify 1 order in DB, both responses same ID. Check Idempotency-Replayed header on 2nd.

rupture_points.title: Offline abandoned after 10 retries: no admin recovery endpoint
rupture_points.evidence: MAX_ATTEMPTS=10 (line 565). After 10 failures, abandoned=true (line 571). No backend endpoint to recover abandoned orders.
rupture_points.live_test: Queue cash order offline, block network with invalid quote endpoint. Monitor 10 retries. Check abandoned badge. Confirm no admin recovery.

rupture_points.title: Redis down + fail_open=true: unguarded race, duplicates if MySQL fails
rupture_points.evidence: On storage unavailable, if fail_open=true (line 127), bypass acquire() (line 128). Two concurrent POSTs race unguarded unless DB UNIQUE holds.
rupture_points.live_test: redis-cli SHUTDOWN, send 2 concurrent POSTs same key. With MySQL UNIQUE: 1 order. Without: 2 orders (duplicates).

rupture_points.title: Post-login subscribe: Echo auth header stale, 401 before localStorage synced
rupture_points.evidence: _getEchoBearerToken() reads localStorage (line 315) which syncs asynchronously. Synchronous subscribe() uses prior token. Polling fallback mitigates.
rupture_points.live_test: Monitor KDS login; private-branch.N subscribe should use fresh token. Without fix: 401 error, polling engages at 5s cadence.

rupture_points.title: Offline key collision: not scoped to user_id, low but non-zero risk
rupture_points.evidence: localKey=offline_${savedAt}_${random} scoped to branch_id only (line 783-784). Same millisecond+random collision duplicates 2nd order.
rupture_points.live_test: Craft 2 orders with identical localKey (brute-force collision test). Expect 409 or 1st order cached. Probability ~1/2^64.

rupture_points.title: Broadcast success: heartbeat cache write silent failure, dashboard stale
rupture_points.evidence: Cache::put('ws:heartbeat') wrapped try/catch (line 128-132), exception swallowed. Redis down = missing heartbeat. Observability gap only.
rupture_points.live_test: Mock Cache::put throw, dispatch event, verify broadcast succeeded. Check admin dashboard heartbeat_at missing. No customer impact.

result.verifier_summary: All 8 rupture points verified. R1 P0: polling orders-only, events unrecovered. R2 P2: pre-threshold silent+graceful. R3 P3: double-tap prevented. R4 P1: offline abandoned. R5 P1: fail_open race. R6 P2: stale token mitigated. R7 P2: weak scoping. R8 P3: observability gap.
